newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Corp in $60 mln Vietnam paper JV.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Corp in $60 mln Vietnam paper JV.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a contract with two Vietnamese firms to set up a $60 million joint venture to produce paper in Vietnam.

Daewoo Corp, a trading unit of the Daewoo Group, said in a statement it would hold a 70 percent stake in the venture, and Vietnam Paper Corp and Haiphong Paper Co will equally share the remaining 30 percent.
The statement said commercial production was due to begin in late 1999 with an annual capacity of 50,000 tonnes of paper for use as cement packages.
Construction on the plant is due to begin immediately after the companies win an approval from the Vietnamese government, the statement said.
